info.title: CashKr Admin API — Vendor Operations 2
info.description: Tags: removedAssignedPincode, store-vendors, vendor-credit, vendor-issue-reports, vendor-payments, vendor-stories

post.summary: Remove pincodes assigned to a vendor
post.description:
Thin proxy that forwards the pincode list and vendor id to the upstream CashkrBackend /removedAssignedPincode endpoint and returns its response verbatim.

**Notes:** Proxies to ${BACKEND_API}/removedAssignedPincode with a Bearer BACKEND_ADMIN_TOKEN header. No handler-level auth check of its own, and errors are returned with a 200 status.

_Source: `app/api/removedAssignedPincode/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

POST-based search/list of store vendors with pagination, sorting, free-text search, city/date filters and a statusFilter that switches the underlying Prisma where clause. Returns a flattened vendor shape including KYC document URLs and credits.

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check despite returning vendor PII and KYC document URLs. Uses POST for a read operation. Heavy query: eagerly includes storeLeads, lead logs, failed-lead documents and all device selections, so keep limit small.

_Source: `app/api/store-vendors/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

Validates and creates a StoreVendors record with KYC document URLs, generating a unique VND_ vendor id. Rejects duplicates by email or phone.

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check - this is an open registration endpoint that writes PII and KYC document URLs. Seven document fields are hard-required by the validator. Uses its own PrismaClient instance and disconnects after each request.

_Source: `app/api/store-vendors/register/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

example.error: Vendor already exists with this email or phone number
Registration failed. Please try again later.

post.description:
Sets the isInternal flag on a vendor identified by vendorId.

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check. Despite the store-vendors path this route updates the vendors table, not storeVendors.

_Source: `app/api/store-vendors/toggle-internal/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

get.summary: List or aggregate vendor credit operations
get.description:
Returns a paginated list of vendor credit operations with vendor details and logs, or aggregated addition/deduction totals when analytics=true. Always floored at the FY start date of 2026-04-01.

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check on GET (unlike POST/PUT on the same file, which require a session). A hard financial-year floor of FINANCIAL_YEAR_START_DATE (2026-04-01) is always applied, so operations from earlier financial years can never be returned.

_Source: `app/api/vendor-credit/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Rows per page

parameters.name: vendorId
parameters.description: Filter to one vendor (uuid)

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Addition or Deduction

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Inclusive start date. Ignored if earlier than the financial-year floor of 2026-04-01.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Inclusive end date; expanded to 23:59:59.999 on that day

parameters.name: analytics
parameters.description: When 'true', returns aggregated totals instead of the operation list

post.summary: Add or deduct vendor credits manually
post.description:
Creates a manual credit addition or deduction for a vendor inside a transaction: writes a creditOperationLogs entry with before/after balances, a vendorCreditOperation row annotated with the acting admin, and updates the vendor's creditsAvailable. Deductions that would go negative are rejected.

**Notes:** MUTATES MONEY: directly changes vendor creditsAvailable. Business errors such as 'Vendor not found' and 'Insufficient credits for deduction' surface as HTTP 500, not 400/404. All writes are transactional. Audit-logged as entity CREDIT, and the reason string is rewritten to include the acting admin's name.

_Source: `app/api/vendor-credit/route.ts`_

_Auth: `session`_

details.message: Number must be greater than or equal to 1

500.description: Vendor not found or insufficient credits

put.description:
Updates only the free-text reason on an existing vendor credit operation. Credit amounts and balances are not touched.

**Notes:** Calls getServerSession() WITHOUT authOptions (unlike POST), which can behave differently from the rest of the app's session checks. Rewrites part of the credit audit trail without recording who edited it or preserving the old text.

_Source: `app/api/vendor-credit/route.ts`_

_Auth: `session`_

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Credit operation id; 400 if missing

post.summary: Upload a voice-note reason for a credit operation
post.description:
Accepts a multipart audio recording and stores it on Linode object storage in the vendor-credit-reasons folder under the key <vendorId>_reason. Returns the URL to pass as reasonAudioUrl when creating the credit operation.

**Notes:** Thin wrapper over lib/utils/audio-reason-upload (shared with the lead fail/reverse actions). Send as multipart/form-data. Upload the recording FIRST, then pass the returned URL as reasonAudioUrl on POST /api/vendor-credit; an abandoned form leaves an orphaned object. The stored key carries a real file extension so mobile WebViews can pick a decoder.

_Source: `app/api/vendor-credit/audio/route.ts`_

_Auth: `session`_

400.description: Missing, empty, oversized or unsupported audio

get.summary: List vendor and cashboy issue reports
get.description:
Triage queue for issue reports with ongoing/solved tabs, status and category filters, date range, free-text search and pagination. Each report is enriched with the reporter's name, phone, email and role, its reply thread newest-first, and an ongoing/solved bucket.

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check despite returning reporter phone numbers and emails. Reporter identity is stitched in with extra queries because vendorId/cashboyId have no FK (the backend owns those tables). Search resolves reporter ids first, capped at 200 vendors and 200 cashboys, so a very common name can miss matches. Tab counts respect every filter except the tab itself.

_Source: `app/api/vendor-issue-reports/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

parameters.name: tab
parameters.description: ongoing (Sent, InReview, Fixing), solved, or all

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Sent, InReview, Fixing or Solved. Overrides the tab when present.

parameters.name: whatHappened
parameters.description: Exact match on the issue category

parameters.name: howOften
parameters.description: Exact match on the frequency field

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Matches ticket number (numeric, with optional # or SR- prefix), reporter name/phone, or the free-text detail field

parameters.name: fromDate
parameters.description: Inclusive start of the createdAt range

parameters.name: toDate
parameters.description: End of the createdAt range; the whole chosen day is included

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Rows per page

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Field to order by; passed straight to Prisma orderBy

parameters.name: sortOrder
parameters.description: asc or desc; anything other than 'asc' is desc

patch.summary: Update an issue report status or reply
patch.description:
Moves an issue report to a new status and/or appends an admin reply to its message log, in one transaction. Stamps resolvedAt when moving to Solved and clears it when reopening.

**Notes:** Replies are append-only and visible to the vendor in their app. Without a session the reply is stored with adminId null, so it appears with no author. Setting Solved stamps resolvedAt only if not already set; moving away from Solved clears it. Audit-logged as VENDOR_ISSUE_REPORT.

_Source: `app/api/vendor-issue-reports/route.ts`_

_Auth: `other: getServerSession is read only to attribute the reply to an admin - the update is not gated, so not gated by the handler itself`_

example.message: Fixed in app build 4.2.1 - please update.

400.description: Validation failed (neither status nor message supplied, or bad status)

details.message: Nothing to update — send a status and/or a message

get.description:
Paginated list of vendor credit payments (approved/rejected) with vendor + GST details and the frozen invoice number. Supports date range, status/gateway filters, id search and a full export mode used by the statement and CA GST downloads.

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check — anyone who can reach the route can read vendor financial + GST data. Always enforces a hard FY floor of 2026-04-01 (FINANCIAL_YEAR_START_DATE) unless searching by id.

_Source: `app/api/vendor-payments/logs/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (ignored when export=true)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Rows per page, clamped to max 100

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start date; floored at the FY start date 2026-04-01

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End date (inclusive, end of day)

parameters.name: export
parameters.description: true returns every row unpaginated, oldest-first, and excludes internal vendors

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: approved | rejected | all (ignored when search is set)

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: all | phonepe | razorpay | manual

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Payment id, INV-number, or any gateway/txn id. Overrides the status and date filters

get.summary: Download frozen tax invoice PDF for a payment
get.description:
Returns the immutable Tax Invoice PDF for an approved vendor payment. Generates and stores the invoice on first access (backstop for legacy/gateway payments approved before invoices were minted), then streams the stored PDF as a same-origin download. A frozen invoice is never regenerated.

**Notes:** Side effect: mints and persists an invoice number + stored PDF on first call. maxDuration 60s, force-dynamic. Response is a binary PDF, not JSON. Cache-Control: private, no-store.

_Source: `app/api/vendor-payments/[paymentId]/invoice/route.ts`_

_Auth: `session`_

parameters.name: paymentId
parameters.description: Numeric VendorPayments.paymentId

200.description: PDF binary (Content-Type: application/pdf, Content-Disposition attachment Tax_Invoice_INV-1131.pdf)

404.description: Payment not found or not approved

500.description: Invoice generation or storage fetch failed

ErrorEnvelope.description: Plain error envelope `{ error }` used by most routes. `error` is a human-readable message.

ErrorDetailsEnvelope.description: Error envelope `{ error, details }` where `details` is a string (usually the underlying exception message).

email.description: Must match a basic email pattern; stored lowercased

status.description: Sent, InReview, Fixing or Solved. At least one of status or a non-empty message must be sent.

message.description: Reply to append to the thread, trimmed, max 2000 chars. Logged against the status the ticket lands in.

UnspecifiedObject.description: Response body shape not captured by the source re-audit (only the status code was detected). Any JSON object.

vendorId.description: Vendor uuid; must be a valid UUID

reason.description: Free-text justification, 1-500 chars. Stored prefixed with the operation type and the acting admin's name.

reasonAudioUrl.description: URL returned by POST /api/vendor-credit/audio; must be a valid URL, max 500 chars, nullable

file.description: Audio recording. Allowed MIME types: audio/webm, audio/ogg, audio/mp4, audio/mpeg, audio/wav, audio/x-m4a (codec suffixes stripped). Must be non-empty and at most 10MB.

vendorId.description: Owning vendor id, used to build the object key; defaults to 'unknown' if omitted

reason.description: Replacement reason text. Not validated here, and written verbatim (the admin-name prefix added on create is not reapplied).

isInternal.description: New value for the internal flag

MessageEnvelope.description: Message-only envelope `{ message }`; used for both success and failure responses.

search.description: Free text over firstName, lastName, email, phoneNumber, shopName, address and exact vendorId. Forces page 1 when present.

city.description: Substring match on the address field

status.description: Accepted but unused by the handler

fromDate.description: ISO date; used only together with toDate to filter createdAt

toDate.description: ISO date; used only together with fromDate

sortBy.description: Field to sort on, default createdAt

statusFilter.description: One of All, InProgress, Application, Payments, vendorDetails, creditDeduct, Failed. Default All.

SuccessMessageEnvelope.description: Envelope `{ success, message }`; `success` is `true` on 2xx and `false` on error responses.

UnauthorizedSuccessFlag.description: Unauthenticated - no valid admin session. Variant for routes that use the `{ success, error }` envelope.

Unauthorized.description: Unauthenticated - no valid admin session (NextAuth cookie), or the expected token/secret is missing or wrong. For operations whose description says *reconstructed from source*, only the status code was detected in the audit; the body shape shown is the codebase convention, not verified per route.

InternalServerError.description: Internal server error - unhandled failure inside the route handler. For operations whose description says *reconstructed from source*, only the status code was detected in the audit; the body shape shown is the codebase convention, not verified per route.

BadRequest.description: Bad request / validation error - a required field is missing or invalid. For operations whose description says *reconstructed from source*, only the status code was detected in the audit; the body shape shown is the codebase convention, not verified per route.

NotFound.description: Not found - the referenced record does not exist. For operations whose description says *reconstructed from source*, only the status code was detected in the audit; the body shape shown is the codebase convention, not verified per route.

cookieAuth.name: next-auth.session-token
cookieAuth.description: NextAuth JWT session cookie from logging in to the admin panel. On HTTPS the cookie name is `__Secure-next-auth.session-token`.

cronBearer.description: `LINODE_CRON_SECRET` as a bearer token — every cron job goes through `assertCronAuth` in `lib/linode/cron-auth.ts`, which reads only this variable (despite some jobs being non-Linode).

unverifiedAccessToken.name: Authorization
unverifiedAccessToken.description: Legacy customer routes: an `accessToken` cookie or an `Authorization` header must be PRESENT, but the value is never verified. Not real authentication.

adsWebhookSecret.name: x-webhook-secret
adsWebhookSecret.description: `ADS_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, sent either as the `x-webhook-secret` header or as a `secret` field in the JSON body. If the env var is unset the route rejects every call with 401 (it does not fall through to unauthenticated access).

webhookSecret.name: x-webhook-secret
webhookSecret.description: Generic `x-webhook-secret` header check for an inbound webhook.

cronSecretBearer.description: `CRON_SECRET` as a bearer token, compared with `bearerMatches` in `lib/auth/secret-compare.ts`. Distinct from `cronBearer`, which uses `LINODE_CRON_SECRET`.
